description: How does a Kidney Transplant save life? Learn about Kidney Transplant by Dr. Priyadarshi Ranjan, one of the Best Kidney Transplant Surgeon in India, based in Chandigarh, Fortis Hospital, Mohali.

His transplant was done against all medical indications. In 2015, I came to know that my Serum protein has increased. When I further investigated, I found out that I had some problem in my kidney. So I contacted many nephrologists and got many tests done. Ultimately, I found out that I have a lot of problems in my kidney. In December 2015, my condition became such that I had to think about kidney transplant. When he got arthritis, slowly his kidneys started to get damaged due to the pain. And at one time, at 28-29 years of age, when we came to know about her kidney disease, we started feeling pain and her kidneys started getting worse. And at the age of 28-29, her kidneys started getting worse. When we came to know that in 2015 she was suffering from kidney disease, we were very scared and scared for her. After all this, we realized that a person suffering from kidney disease has a lot of problems. We were worried that we could lose this person. My son has been very helpful to us. He searched on the internet, from where he could find doctors in India who could transplant him well. My son said that Dr. Ranjan from Fortis has many names on the internet, so we should go to him. I said all I want is to keep my name as well as my father's name on internet. In October, my mother and father came to me and we told them that their kidney was not good. Doctors in India had to perform transplant. I asked for the test done on their mother, who was the donor. We also told them that we her mother were the donors. We suggested her to undergo a test and then start with the treatment and preparation of the transplant. Her creatinine was around 6-8 mg per kg at that time. Her general condition was preserved. Nitin was really educated and her family was also well educated. We decided to have out their transplant, and not have dialysis which is the pre-emptive transplant in their language of choice. In this treatment they do the transplant even before they initiate dialysis. And this is the best form of renal replacement therapy and the best form of renal replacement therapy or best form of transplantation. And the kidneys that is there in this is functioning well. And the patient getting relief is not problem further. Also it is saved from damage that a dielysis causes completely. As we had to do the transplant on 15 December, I swear to the Lord my son told me that has promised no, because of my children's request. So, I decided to do my transplant surgery next month. However this was being delayed for time. In some cases in the formality of the papers, formality or legal documents, this is done by the patient for a long time. So, Nitin helped toin too delayed the treatment. I didn't even hear anything, whether the treatment got a big cost or not, on that day, my son's level of kidney began to increase. Maybe, our decision was wrong. Ultimately, they gave us the date of kidney transplant. I was admitted to Fortinge, but unfortunately, after my admission, my case became very critical with pneumonia, and a lot of water filled up in my lungs. we admitted him in that court but unfortunately I got the pneumonia and due to which our condition became critical as long as we were admitted my lungs were full of water due to which I had to take the dialysis decision When we admitted him for dialysis we tried to insert the dialysis line in the neck we tried the anesthesia but he became so sick that his heart stopped working After seeing all these, we started checking their situation and came to know that our physician was completely fine.
